notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Governing document: AAUP-UC Collective Bargaining Agreement effective 2016-07-01 to 2019-06-30 (Art. 39.1), in force on the reference date. The 2015 news release (2018_00_link) is a summary; the 2015 PPL Procedure (2018_02) is the Provost's implementing procedure; both agree with Art. 19.5 and were used only for detail (source precedence).
No saved file is a navigation-only page.

Population: AAUP bargaining unit (Art. 1.1.1: Instructor, Assistant, Associate and full Professors, librarians; College of Medicine Geographic Faculty excluded, 1.2.5); Uptown and regional campuses alike. Every component except c17 (12-month faculty) and c18 (College of Medicine) uses the main_campus_tenure_stream code.
Calendar: Art. 6.1.1 states the Academic Year 'includes three (3) academic semesters: Fall, Spring, and Summer' without a length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: PPL teaching release for the semester in which PPL is taken (c2, 1 semester) containing the PPL full release (c1, up to 6 weeks, salary), with FMLA (c3, 12 workweeks) concurrent from the PPL start → discretionary Child-Rearing Leave (c4, up to 1 year; or c5 reduced responsibilities instead) consecutive after PPL. Separately: own sick leave (c12) within the Extended Medical Leave with Pay (c14) → Sick Leave Bank (c13) after c12 → unpaid Extended Medical Leave (c15, discretionary, non-STRS/OPERS members) after c14.

Chain, non-birth parent: the same PPL chain (c2 containing c1, FMLA c3 concurrent with c1) → discretionary Child-Rearing Leave (c4 / c5) consecutive after PPL; sick leave (c12) and Extended Medical Leave with Pay (c14) for an Immediate Family Member's illness.

U8 paths: (a) 17.6 allows accumulated sick leave for normal childbirth 'when the parent is not eligible for Paid Parental Leave' (e.g. not the primary caregiver); the member is PPL-eligible, so this path is a note on c12, not linked to c1. (b) Extended medical absence beyond sick leave depends on the retirement system: STRS/OPERS/City members 'must use the benefits available to them under those systems' (17.9.4, terms not saved); others may apply for unpaid Extended Medical Leave (c15) and must apply for LTD (17.9.5). c15 is coded with restriction and rule-gap flags.

PPL pay for the teaching release (c2): coded from 19.5.3's sentence 'will be paid his/her salary for the specified amount of time outlined in this policy', read as covering the whole PPL benefit (19.5.3.1 and 19.5.3.2). If read as covering only the six-week release, c2 would instead carry 'ambiguous: pay level not stated; full pay inferred (R3)'.

Numbering quirks in the agreement: the PPL procedure subsection is numbered '19.2.5 Procedure' inside 19.5; 19.5.6 refers tenure extensions to 'Article 19.2.4', which reads as 19.2.5 (the primary-caregiver extension, c6).

Not components: Academic Leave (Art. 25) and Professional Leave (Art. 26) are professional-development leaves a parent could not take for a birth; Released Time (Art. 23) and Special Duty Assignment (23.3) likewise; Art. 17.9.1.1 alternative duties for intermittent medical absence is a general accommodation; Art. 7.5.12 terminal-year review is a review-timing request, not a clock extension.

Cross-references not saved: LTD insurance plan terms and the Supplemental LTD Plan (Art. 16.7, 17.9.5); STRS/OPERS/City Retirement disability benefits (17.9.4); 'applicable University policies' on extending PPL with sick or vacation leave (19.5.4); Rules of the Board / Rules of the University (Art. 34.2; Board Rules 30-21-02 and 3361:10-1-02); University of Cincinnati Policy and Procedures for Annual Performance Review of Faculty (June 1, 1994); Guidelines on the Maintenance of and Access to Faculty Personnel Files; Administrative Memorandum 118; Student Grievance Procedures; AAUP 1940 Statement / Redbook; Summer Sessions Policy (1997) and University Rule 50-3-11; Librarians' RPT Document; Application for PPL and Certification of Health Care Provider forms. None states parental-leave terms that the saved documents lack, except possibly the LTD plan terms (flagged on c16).
